goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: T009 materially advances the oracle: generated artifacts include a valid GLB, six PNGs, CAS digests, rollback checkpoints, release metadata, and truthful unavailable gates, with CLI/HTTP/MCP/viewer coverage. The remaining system is still one hard-coded lantern recipe. Local QA checks geometry and render presence only; the reference is a local SVG, and no xFarm-style catalog, reference-first manifest, or repair-state evidence exists. Approve a bounded catalog/manifest slice without fabricating provider or Unity results.
evidence: open3d_artist/production.py:16-18 — six fixed views and a single hard-coded recipe registry
tools/production_fixture/generate_fixture.py:145-169 — one generic fixture with local-only QA and no reference manifest
Transient generated run receipt and promotion/release artifacts

worker_package.objective: Add a checked-in xFarm-compatible local qualification catalog around the existing deterministic Blender path: catalog at least three assets (the existing lantern plus watering can and wood crate), resolve only catalog recipe IDs through the existing brief/CLI/HTTP/MCP contract, and emit a per-run reference_manifest.json with six required views, REFERENCE_SAMPLE before CANDIDATE attachments, reference/candidate digests, local technical status, and truthful UNAVAILABLE_REPAIR_REQUIRED and LOCAL_ONLY_NOT_APPROVED states. Test every catalog entry and one promotion/release path.
verify: python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_production_fixture tests.test_production_run tests.test_production_release tests.test_production_catalog

for brief in examples/production-qualification/brief.json examples/production-qualification/brief-watering-can.json examples/production-qualification/brief-wood-crate.json; do run_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; python3 -m open3d_artist production-run --brief "$brief" --output "$run_dir"; python3 -m open3d_artist validate "$run_dir"; test -f "$run_dir/reference_manifest.json"; done

run_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; project_dir="$(mktemp -d)/project"; python3 -m open3d_artist production-run --brief examples/production-qualification/brief-watering-can.json --output "$run_dir"; python3 -m open3d_artist production-promote --run "$run_dir" --project "$project_dir"; python3 -m open3d_artist production-release-verify "$project_dir"
stop_if: Any required change falls outside allowed_files.
Catalog entries permit arbitrary paths, imports, commands, network access, providers, or unsandboxed Blender execution.
Any catalog recipe cannot produce a deterministic .blend/.glb, all six required views, and a digest-checked reference manifest.
The manifest omits REFERENCE_SAMPLE-before-CANDIDATE ordering or converts unavailable visual QA into PASS or APPROVED.
MCP, HTTP, and CLI brief semantics diverge or accept unknown recipe IDs.
The package adds a general asset DSL, batch scheduler, provider integration, Unity integration, visual repair engine, or viewer rewrite.
Verification fails twice without a clear local fix.
